images.name: light
images.prompt:
Ultra-wide 3:1 panoramic game environment 2000x667. Image 1 office supplies softly faceted painterly 3D art, beige retro office palette, blue-gray carpet, wooden desk, ceiling lights and white columns. Image 2 Kyoto supplies broad deep composition, ceiling/floor perspective and paired framing posts. Create a large liminal 1990s office with strong centred depth, seated eye height horizon 48 percent from bottom, gently cylindrical panoramic perspective without fisheye bulge. Two white structural columns frame broad calm central aisle, ceiling grid and carpet seams recede toward central distant glass meeting-room door 10-15m away. Long side areas have furnished workstations, tucked office chairs, filing cabinets, shelves of binders, printers, paper trays, potted plants, and left-side long windows. Keep busy equipment at lateral edges and midground, clear central sightline.
IMPORTANT exception to empty foreground: place ONE natural player desk immediately in front of the seated viewer, normal desktop height ~73cm versus seated eye ~120cm. Warm honey wood rectangular tabletop horizontal and undistorted in central view, shown from gently above; top lies in lower quarter of panorama, rear edge around 75 percent down image, near edge at bottom. Desk central width about 55-65 percent of image, sides visible, not an enormous wall-to-wall counter, not distant across room and not raised to eye height. Large completely bare continuous central tabletop area for adding separate 3D CRT monitor and interactive props in game. NO baked-in monitor, computer tower, keyboard, mouse, mug or stapler on player desk. Only a few existing ivory paper sheets and a small paper stack at far left/right desk edges; centre fully empty including no monitor shadow or glow. Papers have faint gray line marks, no legible writing. Natural perspective tabletop for 3D asset placement, subdued wood grain and gentle even lighting. No hand or weapon.
LIGHT state: soft late-afternoon daylight with pale peach-lavender sky beyond windows, cool white ceiling lights on, warm desk surface, quiet gently surreal office. Same stylized art. No text, UI, logo, vignette, people. Single full-bleed 3:1 panorama.

images.name: dark
images.prompt: Edit this exact office panorama into DARK after-hours night lighting. Preserve identical camera, perspective and every object position: especially exact player desk geometry, tabletop edges, wood grain and all papers, every column, workstation, chair, cabinet, plant, ceiling panel and far meeting room. Lighting ONLY: outside sky deep indigo violet night, main overhead fluorescent lights off or extremely faint, a few existing warm desk lamps and far meeting room glow softly, cool blue-purple window light gives readable silhouettes. Near player desk remains softly and evenly visible in subtle blue ambient fill with warm reflected light, central tabletop completely bare for later 3D monitor and props. No baked-in monitor, monitor shadow, green screen glow, tower, keyboard, mug, stapler or new objects on player's desk. Keep papers at edges. Moody liminal office, readable furnished sides, calm central aisle. Same softly faceted painterly 3D art, ultra-wide 3:1 2000x667. No people, writing, UI, logo or vignette.
